description: Designer leaves a 'TBD' expectation; the reviewer marks it clarification_required and adds an expiry case.

analysis.summary: Coupon entry at checkout; discount rules and validity rules are largely unspecified.

acceptance_criteria.text: A shopper can enter a coupon code on the checkout page.
A valid coupon reduces the order total.
An invalid coupon shows an error message.

findings.text: The discount type and amount of a valid coupon are not specified.
What makes a coupon valid (expiry, minimum order, single use) is not specified.
Can more than one coupon be applied to the same order?
The error message wording and placement for invalid coupons is not defined.

risks.title: Discount applied twice
risks.description: Re-submitting a coupon could stack the discount.

test_cases.title: Coupon code field is available on checkout
test_cases.objective: Verify: Coupon code field is available on checkout.

steps.action: Open the checkout page with one product in the cart.
steps.expected_result: A coupon code input and an Apply button are displayed.

test_cases.title: Valid coupon lowers the order total
test_cases.objective: Verify: Valid coupon lowers the order total.

steps.action: Apply coupon DEMO10 to an order totalling 50.00.
steps.expected_result: The order total is lower than 50.00 and the coupon is shown as applied.

test_cases.title: Valid coupon applies the configured discount amount
test_cases.objective: Verify: Valid coupon applies the configured discount amount.

steps.action: Apply coupon DEMO10 to an order totalling 50.00.
steps.expected_result: The order total is reduced by the discount amount TBD.

test_cases.title: Unknown coupon code shows an error
test_cases.objective: Verify: Unknown coupon code shows an error.

steps.expected_result: An error message is shown next to the coupon field and the total is unchanged.

test_cases.title: Second coupon on the same order
test_cases.objective: Assumes one coupon per order (F-3 unanswered).

steps.expected_result: Only DEMO10 stays applied and an error explains that one coupon is allowed.
